title: Tropical Storm Arthur weakens off Texas' Gulf Coast
description: Tropical Storm Arthur, the first named storm of the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season, formed Wednesday off the Gulf Coast of Texas before later weakening to a post-tropical cyclone.

title: Serena Williams Leaves Door Open For Playing Singles at Wimbledon
description: Serena Williams and Venus Williams will compete in doubles together for the first time in four years at Wimbledon.
